ml_spread_divergence_on_production.classification_evidence: Week-blocked 95% interval [-3.261, +1.974] accuracy points crosses zero -- the expected shape for a real-but-small (or absent) effect at this evaluator's resolution, never grounds to close per AGENTS.md. A positive control (the candidate column replaced by the realized ats_margin) showed the harness DOES detect a huge planted effect (P+ 1.0) inside the full production feature set, so this is not a bounded-by-control closure either. No resolved wrong sign (the interval is not wholly below zero) and no split-half reliability read was made for this trait -- neither admissible closing ground applies.

ml_spread_divergence_on_production.plain_summary: The moneyline (who wins the game outright) and the point spread are two separate prices from the same books. When they disagree a lot about how strong the home team is, we tried siding with the moneyline. In this window it did not help or hurt in a way the test could tell apart from chance.
